description: This file implements logging and exception handling functionalities for the WPEFramework, including crash logging, system file dumps, and exception callbacks.

classes.name: ExceptionCatcher
classes.description: A class implementing a callback for exception handling within a thread, used to dump exception information.

methods.name: ForceLinkage
methods.description: A template method to force linkage of the UnknownCallsign variable.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: Logs the current call stack and exception type when an unhandled exception occurs.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: Logs system information such as memory info, load average, and process status for a given process ID.
